relations.subject: Anne Elizabeth Monius
relations.evidence: She was a professor of South Asian Religions at the Harvard Divinity School ... She joined the Harvard Divinity School in 2002, where she continued till her death. She was made a full professor in 2004.

relations.subject: Anne Elizabeth Monius
relations.evidence: She then went to Harvard University to study theoretical astrophysics. ... She obtained her undergraduate degree in 1986

relations.subject: Anne Elizabeth Monius
relations.evidence: and followed with master's and doctoral degrees (1997) from Harvard.

relations.subject: Anne Elizabeth Monius
relations.evidence: Inspired by a course on Indian civilisation by Diana L. Eck, she switched majors to South Asian religions.

relations.subject: Anne Elizabeth Monius
relations.role: teacher in the department of religious studies
relations.evidence: From 1997 to 2002, Monius taught in the department of religious studies at the University of Virginia.
